lexical.unigrams: exact old stem_body token set, default length>=2 token restriction
lexical.bigrams: unique pairs of adjacent retained alphabetic tokens within each original sentence/paragraph/title; stopword removal DOES NOT bridge a gap; stemmer/stoplist unchanged; no invented pairs from sorted stem_body
lexical.representation: same min_df3 max5000 sublinear TFIDF, 3-fold sigmoid calibrated ensemble LinearSVC; NB uses binary occurrence log smoothed class-count ratio within each calibration training partition
lexical.selection: text-only inner mean BA descending, Brier ascending, smaller C; same as historical SVM

kernel.solver: linear-kernel SVC on explicit concatenated maps, equivalent to sum of block dot-product kernels; 3-fold calibrated ensemble
kernel.set: weighted mean of Gaussian chunk RFF; token weights within article, equal article weights; no final L2 normalization
kernel.geometry: unique training chunks only; median positive sampled paired distance, matching earlier geometry
kernel.interaction: K_set elementwise-multiplied by K_state implemented by tensor product
kernel.selection: mean text-and-price inner BA descending, Brier ascending, C ascending, gamma ascending

table.feature_selection: train chi2 top128 of same bigram TFIDF; PCA32 fit unique training evidence articles

table.selection: LR only: inner mean BA/Brier/C; RF/TabPFN fixed without inner model tuning

residual.name: R16
residual.base: FULL binary chi2top500 OLD16 LR plus PRICE36 fallback; same C grid and inner selection
residual.fit: offset logistic 16 coefficients, no intercept, sum logloss + ||w||^2/(2C)
residual.OOF: fresh 3-fold nested crossfit inside EVERY residual training scope; each base C selected only inside that crossfit complement; never use old selection_oof_NOT_META_TRAIN for fitting
residual.selection: C by original inner folds; include OFF, ties prefer OFF; outer base uses canonical inner folds
residual.PCA: unique training evidence articles only, train evidence scale
residual.gate: no evidence returns base probability bit-exact
